metrics.label: Population density
metrics.description: Census population divided by the historical reported district area.
metrics.quality_note: Historical census areas and GIS areas differ materially for Žacléř, Napajedla and Zlín; see district quality notes.

metrics.label: Population
metrics.description: Total present population at the 1930 census.
metrics.quality_note: Historical census areas and GIS areas differ materially for Žacléř, Napajedla and Zlín; see district quality notes.

metrics.label: Born in the local municipality
metrics.description: Share born in the municipality where enumerated, not merely somewhere in the district.

metrics.label: Children aged 0–14
metrics.description: Children aged 0–14 as a share of total population.

metrics.label: People aged 65 and over
metrics.description: People aged 65+ as a share of total population.

metrics.label: Children and older people per 100 aged 15–64
metrics.description: 100 × (ages 0–14 plus ages 65+) / ages 15–64. Unknown age excluded.
metrics.quality_note: An age ratio, not dependants per employed worker.

metrics.label: Women per 100 men
metrics.description: Present population of all ages.
metrics.quality_note: The ratio alone does not identify war losses or migration.

metrics.label: Widows among all women
metrics.description: Widowed women divided by all women, including children.
metrics.quality_note: A stock at the census, not annual widowhood risk or war-widow prevalence.

metrics.label: Widowers among all men
metrics.description: Widowed men divided by all men, including children.

metrics.label: German nationality
metrics.description: Share recorded in the corresponding census nationality category.
metrics.quality_note: Historical census nationality is distinct from religion and citizenship.

metrics.label: Polish nationality
metrics.description: Share recorded in the corresponding census nationality category.
metrics.quality_note: Historical census nationality is distinct from religion and citizenship.

metrics.label: Jewish nationality
metrics.description: Share recorded in the corresponding census nationality category.
metrics.quality_note: Historical census nationality is distinct from religion and citizenship.

metrics.label: Roman Catholic religion
metrics.description: Share of total population in the named census religious category.

metrics.label: Evangelical religions
metrics.description: Share of total population in the named census religious category.

metrics.label: Czechoslovak Church
metrics.description: Share of total population in the named census religious category.

metrics.label: No religious affiliation
metrics.description: Share of total population in the named census religious category.

metrics.label: Jewish religion
metrics.description: Share of total population in the named census religious category.

metrics.label: Religious composition: effective categories
metrics.description: Inverse sum of squared shares across ten named census categories, including no religion; other/unknown excluded.
metrics.quality_note: Two equally large categories give 2. This is not an actual count of churches or a measure of tolerance.

metrics.label: Agriculture
metrics.description: Employment share among economically active people with a known sector.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification.

metrics.label: Industry and manufacturing crafts
metrics.description: Employment share among economically active people with a known sector.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification.

metrics.label: Tertiary sector
metrics.description: Employment share among economically active people with a known sector.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification.

metrics.label: Transport
metrics.description: Employment share among economically active people with a known sector.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification.

metrics.label: Forestry, hunting and fishing
metrics.description: Employment share among economically active people with a known sector.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification.

metrics.label: Employment diversity: effective branches
metrics.description: Inverse sum of squared employment shares across eight broad census branches.
metrics.quality_note: Denominator: economically active population with a known sector. Vsetín and Vejprty withheld pending source verification. Industry is one broad category; this is not within-industry diversity.

metrics.label: SdP vote share
metrics.description: Party votes divided by valid votes in the Chamber of Deputies election.
metrics.source: Czech Statistical Office · inherited district election panel
metrics.quality_note: 326 displayed: Praha-sever and Zlín missing; both Brno districts withheld pending territorial reconciliation.

metrics.label: KSČ vote share
metrics.description: Party votes divided by valid votes in the Chamber of Deputies election.
metrics.source: Czech Statistical Office · inherited district election panel
metrics.quality_note: 326 displayed: Praha-sever and Zlín missing; both Brno districts withheld pending territorial reconciliation.

metrics.label: Change in KSČ vote share
metrics.description: 1935 share minus 1929 share among conservatively matched districts.
metrics.source: Czech Statistical Office · audited election crosswalk
metrics.quality_note: Unavailable or uncertain matches, including Brno, withheld. Aggregate change does not trace individual voters.

metrics.label: Mean annual temperature
metrics.description: Annual mean temperature averaged over 28 years.
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records.

metrics.label: Mean annual precipitation
metrics.description: Annual precipitation total averaged over 28 years.
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records.

metrics.label: Growing-season rainfall anomaly, 1935
metrics.description: 100 × (seasonal precipitation / local 1901–1928 mean for the same months − 1).
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records. A precipitation deficit is not a measured crop loss. April–September 1935 includes months after the May 1935 election; this full-season measure is not a pre-election weather exposure.

metrics.label: July–January temperature difference
metrics.description: Difference of long-run monthly mean temperatures; not daily extremes.
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records.

metrics.label: Summer share of annual precipitation
metrics.description: June–August mean precipitation sum divided by the annual mean sum.
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records.

metrics.label: Spring ground-frost days
metrics.description: Mean sum of CRU FRS for April and May.
metrics.source: CRU-TS v4.10, Climatic Research Unit, University of East Anglia
metrics.quality_note: Empirically derived ground-frost frequency, not direct local event counts or the date of the last frost. Area-weighted 0.5° grid: 60 cells underlie 330 districts; 82 districts occupy a single cell. These are not 330 independent station records.

metrics.label: Mean terrain elevation
metrics.description: Area average of the district terrain, not the altitude of its administrative town.
metrics.quality_note: Geographic context; not an observation made in 1930.

metrics.label: Mapped river density
metrics.description: Total clipped river reach length divided by GIS district area.
metrics.quality_note: Threshold-defined network excludes many small streams; not historical navigation or flow.

metrics.label: Mean distance to a mapped river
metrics.description: Average nearest-river distance from regular 1 km sample points within each district.
metrics.quality_note: Area-sampled accessibility, not population-weighted distance or transport access.

metrics.label: Intersecting level-8 drainage basins
metrics.description: Count of level-8 basin polygons intersecting the historical district.
metrics.quality_note: A topographic subdivision count, not rainfall or an interwar discharge observation.

metrics.label: Operating railway density
metrics.description: Length of the spatial union of operating tracks inside the district divided by GIS area.
metrics.source: Ondřej Bedrunka, Palacký University (2023) · derived district statistics
metrics.quality_note: Corrected Horní Lideč–Púchov opening: 1937. Poříčany–Nymburk lacks source geometry; source coverage is present-day Czechia.

metrics.label: Distance to operating railway
metrics.description: Straight-line distance from a district interior point to the nearest operating track.
metrics.source: Ondřej Bedrunka, Palacký University (2023) · derived district statistics
metrics.quality_note: Distance to track, not a railway station or population-weighted access. Cross-border source truncation may matter.

metrics.label: Distance to the Czechoslovak state border
metrics.description: Distance from a district interior point to the external Czechoslovak border.
metrics.quality_note: Generalised historical boundaries; interior point is not the district town.

metrics.label: Forest share, 1845
metrics.description: Forest area allocated from harmonised LUCC units by polygon overlap, divided by allocated total area.
metrics.source: LUCC Czechia, Ivan Bičík and colleagues, Charles University
metrics.quality_note: Areal estimate; 1845 represents a cadastral source slice, approximately surveys of 1826–1843.

metrics.label: Forest share, 1948
metrics.description: Area-allocated forest share on fixed district boundaries.
metrics.quality_note: Postwar reference slice. Not an observation of land use in 1930.

metrics.label: Change in forest share, 1845–1948
metrics.description: 1948 forest share minus 1845 forest share on fixed 1930 boundaries.
metrics.quality_note: Long-run context including years before and after the republic; cannot isolate the interwar change.

metrics.label: Clay content, 0–30 cm
metrics.description: Depth-thickness and area-weighted clay fraction in valid soil cells.
metrics.quality_note: 37 districts below 90% texture coverage withheld. Modern model, not 1930 fertility or yield.

metrics.label: Soil pH in water, 0–30 cm
metrics.description: Depth-thickness and area-weighted descriptive mean pH in valid soil cells.
metrics.quality_note: Coverage below 90% withheld. A modern descriptive arithmetic average, not a historical soil measurement.

metrics.label: Share of the dominant geological map unit
metrics.description: District share assigned to its largest source legend category.
metrics.quality_note: Category composition and mixed lithology descriptions remain in the downloadable tables; scale is not parcel precision.

metrics.label: Registered mineral deposits and resources
metrics.description: Distinct current register records intersecting the historical district.
metrics.quality_note: Modern register. Does not identify active interwar mines, output or historical employment.

metrics.label: Historical gazetteer locality codes
metrics.description: Distinct referenced locality codes assigned to each district polygon.
metrics.source: Karel Kuča / SOVAMM, CZ_RETRO via NPÚ
metrics.quality_note: Mixed historical and current references; not the number of active municipalities in 1930.

metrics.label: Neighbours sharing a boundary segment
metrics.description: Rook neighbours: districts sharing a line, excluding point-only contact.
metrics.source: Own calculation from Historický GIS district geometries
metrics.quality_note: Use supplied weights and distance tables for spatial analyses, with boundary-quality flags.
